data.narrative:
Focused Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Thomas Forner and Markus Roth that has raised $240M to date. The nuclear energy sector comprises 3 public comps (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, though the private peer set remains concentrated at early stages with limited same-stage comparables.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next funding round. Using total capital raised ($240M) as a proxy baseline, this method implies a valuation of $480M. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables in nuclear energy—while four same-sector peers exist, none met minimum datapoint thresholds (≥3) after filtering for stage, round proximity, or valuation tier.

The triangulated valuation range is $408M to $552M, with a median of $480M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for nuclear-sector Series A progression and the absence of direct peer-median anchoring. Investors should note that the nuclear energy comparable universe remains sparse and early-stage weighted, limiting confidence in cross-validation. Further data on capital deployment efficiency and technology differentiation relative to the peer set would strengthen conviction in this range.
